string-array.name: changelog_app_items
string-array.item: Add servers in seconds: scan the QR code or type the 6-digit code – encrypted, with a security check
Try everything first with the built-in demo server
Live overview: players, TPS, MSPT, memory, uptime and worlds, with charts of the last hour, day or week
Customize the overview: move cards, change their size or hide them
Players: health, position, playtime, your own notes and the inventory; message, heal, game mode, teleport, kick or ban – also several at once
Whitelist and ban list – with undo
Coloured live console with suggestions that also work offline, search and filters
Command menu with all server commands, favorites and macros
Chat: read along live and write to everyone
World settings: time, weather, difficulty and game rules
Scheduled tasks, e.g. a nightly restart with a warning
Plugin list and server files: edit configs, read logs, upload plugins, deleted files can be restored
Notifications: server offline, lag, players joining, chat mentions – with quiet hours and quick reply
Home screen widget and quick settings tile
Opens instantly with the last data; offline it shows how old it is
Several servers with folders, pins and search; limited access for moderators and viewers
Help & guide with search and pictures
Light and dark, 9 colours or your own, 10 languages, tablet layout
Updates right in the app (GitHub version)

string-array.name: changelog_plugin_items
string-array.item: For Paper, Purpur, Folia and Spigot from Minecraft 1.20.6
Pairing with /remotemc pair: QR code as an in-game map or in the console – the map disappears after pairing or when thrown away
Encrypted connection with its own certificate
Roles admin, moderator and viewer; every phone\'s access can be revoked
Live data without delay: console, chat, players and status
Performance history for 7 days
Access tokens and codes never show up in the console
Audit log of every action
Scheduled commands with a countdown in the chat
Messages in 10 languages and an update check

string-array.name: changelog_windows_items
string-array.item: Everything from the phone on the PC: overview, players, console, chat, worlds, plugins, tasks and files
Several servers in tabs, resizable split views
Command menu, favorites, macros and console search (Ctrl+F)
Select several players with Ctrl+click
Windows notifications with quiet hours; keeps running in the tray
Installer with its own Java; updates itself with a pop-up in the bottom right corner
Animations, colour themes, light and dark, 10 languages
